headlines.title: Bernie Sanders and Greg Casar propose AI ‘superintelligence’ ban with a 20-year jail penalty
headlines.description: New legislation authored by Sen. Sanders, I-Vt., and Rep. Casar, D-Texas, also calls for a Cabinet-level secretary of AI to regulate artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: FBI investigating hacking group’s claim of massive breach of agent info
headlines.description: ShinyHunters, a cyber-extortion outfit, said it hacked into the FBI’s jobs portal and used that access to steal a major tranche of sensitive files.

headlines.title: 20 nations call for new global body to oversee AI ahead of U.N. General Assembly
headlines.description: Leaders and representatives from 20 countries released a statement Monday afternoon calling for increased oversight of advanced AI systems.

headlines.title: AI glasses: The lens technology bringing AI into your line of sight
headlines.description: AI glasses are moving beyond simple displays. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer visits South Korean startup LetinAR to explore its PinTILT lens technology, designed to put AI and digital information directly in your line of sight.

headlines.title: Zuckerberg shows Meta's audio-only glasses, addresses safety concerns
headlines.description: NBC News' Joanna Stern sat down with Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg to talk about their audio-only glasses and how the company is responding to people misusing the products.

headlines.title: 'People must remain at the center of AI decision-making,' OpenAI CEO says
headlines.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Dario Amodei, the CEO of Anthropic, spoke about the risks of artificial intelligence in their remarks at the United Nations General Assembly. The top AI chief executives stressed that people should remain at the center of AI decision-making.

headlines.title: FBI investigating after hackers claim they stole sensitive data about agents
headlines.description: The FBI said it was investigating after a hacker group said they broke into a database and stole sensitive information regarding the bureau's agents. The group allegedly responsible said the attack was not financially motivated.

headlines.title: Man versus Robot: Influencer takes on humanoid robot in cage match
headlines.description: An influencer stepped into the ring to take on a six-foot, 200-pound robot. NBC News’ Steven Romo takes a closer look at the match.

headlines.title: Promoter of viral human vs. robot kickboxing match sees 'insane' demand for more
headlines.description: In something out of a sci-fi movie, a TikTok influencer fought a humanoid robot in San Francisco. And while the company putting on the show said the human won two out of three bouts, the spectacle shows just how far the robots have advanced. NBC News’ Steven Romo reports.

headlines.title: Trumps says the U.S. will 'only encourage superintelligence' in AI
headlines.description: President Trump said in his remarks at the United Nations General Assembly that the U.S. would "only encourage superintelligence" when it comes to AI development, a notable declaration as warnings about the potential catastrophic consequences of the technology have spread.

headlines.title: Scott Bessent meets with Chinese official on AI safety
headlines.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says that the U.S. is proposing a new AI safety notification mechanism for President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping to consider at their upcoming Washington summit. NBC News' Allie Canal reports on the ongoing U.S.-China discussions regarding AI safety.

headlines.title: Breaking down the proposals lawmakers are considering to regulate AI
headlines.description: Congress is facing growing calls to put new safeguards on advanced AI. NBC News’ Sahil Kapur breaks down four key proposals from lawmakers and what they could mean for the future of artificial intelligence.
